nodes.description: Caller address supplied by the transaction; used for ownership setup, owner checks, balance debits and allowances.
Owned.owner: privileged address controlling the contract; written in the Owned constructor and acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
KVCToken.symbol public metadata set in the constructor to "KVC".
KVCToken.name public metadata set in the constructor.
KVCToken.decimals public metadata set to 18.
KVCToken._totalSupply: total minted token amount, read by totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) balances: token ledger mutated by transfer/transferFrom and the constructor mint.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowance ledger mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, initialising privileged access control.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner; stages newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then finalises ownership handover.
KVCToken constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): view returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits to using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend check.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits from-balance and msg.sender allowance, credits to.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): view of the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then invokes the spender contract callback.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after the allowance write.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) against an attacker-chosen token address.
